create_transform_gaussian_blur: create an ImgPilGaussianBlur transform with probability 0.5 and radius range 0.1 to 2.0
build_transform_from_config: build an ImgPilGaussianBlur instance from a configuration dictionary with p, radius_min, and radius_max
apply_gaussian_blur_to_image: apply random gaussian blur to a PIL image using the ImgPilGaussianBlur transform
register_transform_class: register ImgPilGaussianBlur as a named transform using the @register_transform decorator
test_imgpil_gaussian_blur: test the ImgPilGaussianBlur transform with various probability and radius parameters
